narrative: The market is undergoing a severe risk-off correction as the AI-driven growth narrative faces a reality check following the Anthropic IPO and scrutiny of major tech players like Nvidia and AMD. Investors are aggressively raising cash and rotating into defensive assets as 10-year real rates hit 3% and 10-year yields sustain levels above 5%. Market sentiment has shifted from hype to concerns over monetization, feasibility, and the sustainability of high-growth valuations. Broad-based liquidation is impacting even safe-haven assets like gold, while volatility has spiked with the VIX holding above 30. The Fed remains focused on inflation control, further pressuring equity valuations in a 'muddle-through' economic environment.

Nasdaq.why: The index is nearing bear market territory, down nearly 20% from its October record as the AI trade unwinds and investors de-risk.

S&P 500.why: The index has officially entered correction territory, falling over 10% from its all-time high amid the broadest sell-off of the year.

Gold.why: Gold is experiencing significant selling pressure as part of a broad-based asset liquidation, with prices dropping 2.65% to $3,530.

Oil.why: Views are split; while some anchors noted downward pressure on Brent due to demand concerns, others reported modest gains for WTI and Brent despite the broader market downturn.

priced_in: Heightened market volatility with VIX above 30-32
Reduced probability of a December Fed rate hike
debates: Whether the AI trade is a sustainable growth driver or a bubble facing a permanent valuation reset
The impact of Donald Trump's criticism of the Fed on future monetary policy
The sustainability of corporate AI capex given the high cost of capital
